settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize the application to your needs
settings.fontSizeDesc: Text size used in the mobile applications
settings.fontFamilyDesc: Letter style used in the mobile applications

fontFamilyReasons.default: Inter is a neutral, widely-tested system font with open letterforms and consistent spacing — a safe, legible baseline for most readers.
fontFamilyReasons.rounded: Nunito's rounded, simplified letterforms feel friendlier and are easier to distinguish for younger readers and readers with intellectual/developmental disabilities.
fontFamilyReasons.legible: Atkinson Hyperlegible was designed by the Braille Institute specifically to maximize letter distinction for readers with low vision or reading difficulties — recommended when legibility matters most.

settings.colorSchemeDesc: Color scheme used in the mobile applications

colorSchemeReasons.default: A balanced indigo/green/amber palette suited to everyday use when no specific accessibility need is in play.
colorSchemeReasons.highContrast: Black text on a yellow background gives the strongest possible visual contrast, making it easier to hold attention and tell elements apart — recommended for readers who need maximum visual distinction.
colorSchemeReasons.pastel: Lower-saturation tones reduce visual intensity for readers who find bright/high-contrast colors overstimulating.
colorSchemeReasons.warm: Warmer tones offer an alternative general-purpose feel for readers who simply prefer it — color response varies from person to person.

guide.welcomeDesc: A quick tour of how the parent dashboard works. You can reopen this any time from the help button (?) in the top bar.
guide.childrenDesc: Open the "Children" page from the left menu and click "Add child" to create a profile for each child.
guide.appsDesc: On the "Applications" page, assign the apps a child should use — only assigned apps appear on their device.
guide.preferencesDesc: On the "Preferences" page choose font, text size, colours and high contrast. These sync automatically to every app the child uses.
guide.qrDesc: Open the child's profile to show a QR code. In the mobile app the child scans it to log in — no password needed.
guide.statisticsDesc: The "Statistics" page shows time spent, completed activities, accessibility metrics and weekly check-ins for each child.
